commonDescription:
Returns the identity of the user Stroom is processing as. This is mainly useful in interactive
processing, such as a search.
commonReturnDescription: The requested user identity, or an empty sequence if unavailable.
name: current-user

signatures.description: Returns the user's display name, falling back to the subject identifier.

args.description: `display` (default), `subject` or `full`. Unknown or empty values use `display`.
args.name: form

signatures.description: Returns the selected form of the user's identity.
